communes: São João Das Lampas E Terrugem

blurb.text: A coastal area in Sintra where vines grow directly in sand behind dunes. Phylloxera cannot live in sand, so the old Ramisco vines are ungrafted. The wines are deep red, full-bodied and very tannic.
